name: 会話の共有資料と保存項目の件数
prompt:
Recreate only the two-row WhatsApp contact-info card shown in the reference crop, as an isolated Japanese UI component on a 390×132 white canvas. Keep the original screenshot crop authoritative for the card silhouette, rounded corners, icon scale, row spacing, gray page edge, one thin divider between rows, and right-side chevrons. Use the native preview for the Japanese copy and target canvas.

Exact labels: 「写真・リンク・資料」 with gray count 「3件」; second row 「保存したメッセージ」 with gray count 「なし」. Preserve the photo-outline icon and outlined star at the left, and subtle gray chevrons at the far right. Use Meiryo Regular for both row labels at 14px/24px in #1D1D1D; use Meiryo Regular 12px/16px in #6E6E6E for counts. Keep the labels dark. 「写真・リンク・資料」 names a category; it is not a hyperlink. These are navigation rows with icons and chevrons. Do not turn any label blue. If a real hyperlink were present it would be blue, but this component has none.

Do not add the contact header, avatar, status bar, unrelated settings rows, extra lines, buttons, or new text. Keep Japanese glyphs intact and clean. Avoid decorative effects, shadows, gradients, and substitutions for the original icons. Produce a crisp, flat, editable-looking interface crop with faithful alignment and restraint.
reviewNotes: All four Japanese values are legible and labels remain dark; row alignment is close to the source crop. Residual: attempt 1 added an outline stroke around the white card instead of relying on the light-gray page background, and the icon strokes/chevrons are grayer than the source. Needs a second pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
